description: TRUE identity 63-7559; the aircraft is FALSELY MARKED as 68-566 per Joe Baugher; ex-558th TFS 12th TFW then 390th TFS 366th TFW then Missouri and California ANG; previously preserved at Dobbins; restored by 116th Maintenance Group and towed to a pad in front of wing headquarters on 20 July 2021 and dedicated 1 October 2021 for the 128th squadron's 80th anniversary
museum_name: 116th Air Control Wing Heritage Display -- Robins Air Force Base

description: TRUE identity 63-8345; FALSELY MARKED as 62-4425 - the real 62-4425 is at American Legion Post 325 Blissfield Michigan; built as F-105F and upgraded to F-105G-1-RE; 562nd TFS 35th TFW then Georgia ANG 128th TFS from 1982; Baugher records it moved from Dobbins to the Robins ANG display in 2020; Wikipedia still lists it at Dobbins and is stale
